name: emergency_protocol.txt
text:
[GENERAL ANNOUNCEMENT]

All emergency protocols must be triggered by personnel with Level 7 or higher access to the Facility or automatically by C.A.S.S.I.E.

During the emergency evacuation procedure, pay close attention to official communication channels and your personal channels. The system will automatically send an Emergency Access Code to your personal terminals. 

Any action taken by C.A.S.S.I.E. requires confirmation of this code.

If the emergency level is very high, any board member or agent with Level 7 or higher access who enters the code incorrectly may trigger the facility’s self-destruct system if the “Dead Man’s Switch” is active.

Follow the instructions from all USEC and USEC ISB MTFs throughout the evacuation protocol. 

TerraGroup. Your safety is our priority.

name: facility_power.txt
text:
[GENERAL ANNOUNCEMENT]

A reminder to everyone!

The facility’s power system is divided into several power cells. During emergencies, it may be necessary to activate the auxiliary cells.

Since Cell “D” contains several pipes, it can only be activated after the other three power cells have been activated. Once Cell D has been activated, contact an administrative staff member in the Violet Zone to activate the main cell.

TerraGroup. Your safety is our priority.

name: decontamination_protocol.txt
text:
[CONFIDENTIAL] [ACCESS LEVEL 8] | EMERGENCY PROTOCOL III

Hello, Dr. Harp!

C.A.S.S.I.E. is programmed to activate the decontamination system in the event of a Level 10 containment breach—particularly in cases involving Euclids and Keter.

If the decontamination process begins, evacuate yourself and your team immediately. USEC operators will assist you with the procedure, as once decontamination begins, the facility will be flooded with concentrated carbon monoxide, which will asphyxiate any creature or biological entity.

If this is a false alarm, please check your personal control panel; you will receive an emergency code to deactivate the procedure.

Thank you for your attention!

Klen March, TerraGroup Researcher.

kteBriefing.introduction:
Hello, Dr. Harp!

I am forwarding the list of KTEs based on last week’s research. We were unsuccessful with most of the items, but we have cataloged the properties of 5 of them.

entries.brief: Contact with the object appears to increase carrying capacity and endurance. Repeated unexplained injuries have also been recorded; prolonged exposure is not recommended.
Following injection, test subjects show a sustained loss of mobility. No beneficial properties have been identified.
Keeping the object nearby causes recurring injuries in apparently random parts of the body. The source of the damage remains unidentified.
Contact produces extraordinary physical aggression and rapid recovery, including reduced hunger and thirst. Recurrent episodes of severe bleeding make unsupervised exposure unacceptable.
The object appears to materialize roubles at regular intervals. Further research is needed to identify the origin of the currency.
Test subjects carrying the object can jump substantially higher. Periodic exhaustion, hunger and thirst require continued observation.
Exposure rapidly depletes the subject's energy and hydration. No compensating benefits have been observed.
The object promotes gradual healing and appears to strengthen already recovered body tissue. The additional resilience does not persist after the exposure period.
Following injection, a supernatural increase in various properties of the human body is noticeable. Safety testing required.
Records indicate that the disk can preserve the subject's equipment following death. A single disk is consumed when this property activates; the retrieval mechanism remains unexplained.
Subjects carrying the object experience a pronounced loss of movement speed. No other useful properties have been cataloged.
Injection enables perception of heat signatures for the remainder of the field test. Persistent pain accompanies the effect.
Keeping the object nearby allows the subject to see in darkness without conventional night-vision equipment. No adverse effects have been observed so far.
The object causes periodic localized injuries without external contact. Head injuries have not been recorded in these tests.
Following injection, subjects can see in darkness for the remainder of the field test. Persistent pain prevents classification as a harmless substance.
The object appears to materialize euros at regular intervals. The resulting currency has been isolated for further examination.
Proximity to the object causes tunnel vision and fatigue. Consumption is not required for these symptoms to appear.
Exposure produces continuous injuries throughout the body. Immediate separation from the object is recommended.
The object suppresses exhaustion, hunger and thirst. Recurring injuries have also been observed and require medical supervision.
Subjects carrying the object inflict unusually severe injuries during controlled tests. The effect's mechanism remains unknown.

The object can interrupt an otherwise fatal injury, repair damaged limbs and briefly protect and heal the subject. It is consumed on activation; repeated protection with the same device is impossible.
When worn over the face, the object provides substantial ballistic protection. Repeated brief episodes of complete loss of vision have been recorded.
The object appears to reproduce the effects of Propital at regular intervals without being consumed. No negative properties have been identified so far.
Injection not recommended. Appears to cause extreme discomfort in every way.
Injection suppresses pain for the remainder of the field test. No negative properties have been observed so far.
Somehow appears to materialize dollars. Further research is needed to identify any negative effects.
Following injection, subjects display apparently inexhaustible stamina alongside continuous injuries throughout the body. Sustained exposure is dangerous.
Friendly appearance. Records and tests on test subjects indicate that keeping the object nearby causes various positive, protective effects.
The object rapidly restores the subject's stamina despite its unusually low apparent weight. Further tests are needed to explain this behavior.
Test subjects exposed to KTE 728 report extreme discomfort, panic attacks, and anxiety.
Proximity induces a Berserk state in the subject. No negative properties have been identified in the current records.
Keeping the object nearby substantially reduces injuries from external attacks. Hunger and thirst increase throughout exposure.
Subjects carrying the object become unable to jump. The restriction ceases when contact ends; no benefits have been cataloged.
At close range, the object can unlock secured doors without their keys. Its capacity is limited and the object disappears when depleted.
Subjects carrying the object show an unexplained increase in jumping height. No adverse properties have been recorded so far.
Following injection, subjects sustain significantly less damage from external attacks for several minutes. No adverse effects have been recorded so far.
Contact prevents jumping and severely impairs movement speed. No beneficial properties have been identified.

name: research_report.txt
text:
[CONFIDENTIAL] [ACCESS LEVEL 9] | RESEARCH INFORMATION.

Hello, Dr. Harp!

All research involving the virus has been a success. Unlike last week, we lost only two test subjects. The physical reactions appear to be as expected.

Keep all samples out of press reports. And all antidotes must be secured and kept under observation. Once the virus has been fully extracted and modified, we can begin Phase 2.

Don’t forget to forward the entire emergency and containment protocol to Black [REDACTED] in case anything gets out of control.

Klen March, TerraGroup Researcher.
